openCallsSettled.Q254 (n19): Covered. Card admission-of-partner.entry-e-goodwill-not-brought gives Incoming Partner's CURRENT A/c Dr To Sacrificing Partners' Capital A/c, the keyed option; the 9,000/6,000 split is the old ratio 3:2 (fact-nothing-specified-old-ratio). The Capital A/c option is a distractor our material does not teach.
openCallsSettled.Q267 (n32): Covered, the weakest covered call. Three pairs are exact cards; the cash-issue pair is taught by def-over-subscription (debentures offered to the public, applied for) and the application-money entry card; only the word "prospectus" is missing for debentures.
openCallsSettled.Q281 (n46): Covered. Royalties operating, interest/dividends received investing, share issue financing are exact cards; "current investment = cash and cash equivalents" is the pairing our card fact-purchase-equivalents-not-considered teaches (short-term investment constituting cash equivalents). The paper's pairing is loose, but our material agrees with the key.
openCallsSettled.Q259 (n24): Covered. NTA keys Gaining Partners' Capital A/c Dr To P&L Suspense A/c; card entry-death-close-suspense states exactly that. No served item teaches the older year-end close to P&L A/c, so a student is not misled.
openCallsSettled.Q262 (n27): On syllabus ("Features and type of companies" in the 2026 syllabus) and covered: card share-capital.fact-opc-limits states the Rs 2 crore turnover limit the key uses (the rule was amended in 2021, but NTA keyed Rs 2 crore as NCERT prints it).
openCallsSettled.Q264 (n29): Covered: served bank ed41d458 asks the 90% directly and card fact-min-sub-90 quotes the SEBI DIP 2000 wording.

numericalTemplatesMissing.template: Interest on capital with mid-year additional capital and a withdrawal (time-weighted months)
Interest on capital when profit is less than total interest: share profit in the ratio of interest
Reverse super profit: from goodwill, years' purchase, average profit and capital, find the normal rate of return
Super profit with partners' salary deducted from past profits; compare two averaging bases, take the lower
Profit to date of death on the sales (turnover) basis
Net revaluation profit/loss from several asset increases and decreases
Sacrificing ratio when old partners agree a new mutual ratio on admission (result differs from the old ratio)
Number of shares issued to a vendor at a premium (price less cash paid, over issue price)
Forfeiture where allotment money including premium is unpaid; back out the paid amount; reissue at discount; capital reserve
Debentures issued to a vendor at a discount: number of debentures and the entry
Debentures issued at a premium payable in instalments: application, allotment (with premium) and call amounts
Cash realised when a partner takes over part of an asset and the rest is sold at a gain/loss
Interest coverage ratio from profit after tax, tax rate and debt interest rate

theoryFactsMissing.fact: At retirement (fixed capitals) current account balances are transferred to capital accounts before settlement; order Revaluation, Current, Capital, Balance Sheet
AS 26 is the Accounting Standard on intangible assets (definition)
Intangible assets are written off over estimated life not exceeding 10 years (AS 26); plus AS 26 deals with intangibles
Freezing a formula: select, Copy, Paste Special, Values, OK
